verdict.rationale: Runtime probes confirm agent-oriented docs on two sites: 1password.dev serves llms.txt and llms-full.txt with a .md mirror for every page, and support.1password.com serves its own llms.txt. A dedicated AI-readable-docs page and a public, keyless docs MCP server add further agent-facing access. missing for 10: per-page markdown on the support site (the probed support .md path returned 404), independent community corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: 1password.dev serves llms.txt ('# 1Password Developer Documentation') plus llms-full.txt, and every docs page has a real .md mirror
Use ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, or similar web chat to ask questions about 1Password developer tools.
1Password's public docs MCP server at https://www.1password.dev/mcp completed a FULL keyless initialize handshake
